name: fantom-mcp
description: Working knowledge of Fantom, Axon, Haxall and SkySpark code from the Fantom MCP server: semantic search, call graph, impact, change history, docs, SkySpark 3.x to 4.0 migration. Hooks report your edits to the server and inject the current project's context at session start.

mcp_url.title: Fantom MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Streamable HTTP MCP URL. Default goes through the local mcp-proxy on :9191 so the connector stays up while the server restarts.

server_url.title: Fantom MCP server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the server itself (health, change reports, session context). No trailing slash.

report_token.title: Report token
report_token.description: Token from Dashboard > Indexing > Report token (or claudePlugin/scripts/install-local.sh). Lets the hooks report edits and read project context. Falls back to FANTOM_REPORT_TOKEN or ~/.fantom-mcp/report-token.
